articles.title: New Ownership of PostalAnnex in Kerman, California Brings Fresh Energy to the Business--Serving the Community with Shipping and Office Services for Nearly 30 Years
articles.mainIdea: New Ownership of PostalAnnex in Kerman, California Brings Fresh Energy to the Business--Serving the Community with Shipping and Office Services for Nearly 30 Years
articles.summary: PR Newswire: New Ownership of PostalAnnex in Kerman, California Brings Fresh Energy to the Business--Serving the Community with Shipping and Office Services for Nearly 30 Years. Annex Brands, Inc., a leading franchisor in the packing, shipping, and office services industries, is pleased to announce the successful transfer of ownership of an existing PostalAnnex location in Kerman, CA to new owner, Helen Shergill-Barandalla. This transition to new ownership ensures that the community will benefit from the essential Shipping and Office Services provided by this PostalAnnex for nearly 30 years. Related tickers mentioned: FDX.
